As for the temperature/CO2 graph, looking at a graph and saying "look, it looks like 1 line is before the other" is a common statistical fallacy known as correlation != causation.

Milankovitch cycles are caused by many factors. Planets orbiting, the precession of the earth, axial tilt, etc. Just because they made temperature go up first in the past in some cases does not mean there is no link between CO2 in temperature.

Fortunately, science means that they all could be wrong.
